title: VTX Platform Events Schema
description: Event formats emitted by the VTX platform over SSE and internal message brokers

ExecutionIntentCreatedV1.description: Payload persisted to outbox_events.payload for event_type execution_intent.created.v1 (VTX-2 → VTX-3). changelog_id is the Jira changelog.id — NOT a Jira workflow transition ID. occurred_at is the Jira webhook envelope timestamp normalized to UTC; occurred_at_source records whether it came from the webhook timestamp or fell back to the intake received_at.

issue_id.description: Authoritative Jira issue.id (re-fetched, never trusted from the payload)

changelog_id.description: Jira changelog.id of the accepted status transition

target_status_id.description: changelog `to` status ID; always a configured start_status_id

TaskRunCreatedV1.description: Payload persisted to outbox_events.payload for event_type task_run.created.v1 (VTX-3 → VTX-5). Emitted inside the same transaction that admits the run, so it exists if and only if the run exists.

state.description: Always queued: a run is born queued at version 0

TaskRunStateChangedV1.description: Payload for event_type task_run.state_changed.v1 (VTX-3 → VTX-5). Emitted in the same transaction as the task_runs update and the audit row, so a published event always has a committed audit record at the same version.

TaskRunIntentDeferredV1.description: Payload for event_type task_run.intent_deferred.v1 (VTX-3 → VTX-5). A second intent arrived while the task already had an active run; it is queued FIFO in deferred_intents and no run was created.

task_id.description: registry_tasks.id of the task the intent was deferred for

reason.description: Why the intent was deferred; currently active_run_in_progress

TaskRunAdmittedV1.description: Emitted inside the admission tx (VTX-5) after lease grant + queued→preparing transition. live_slots is the post-admission live-slot count — observable proof the ≤3 invariant held at commit time.

DeferredIntentPromotedV1.description: A pending_deferred intent was promoted: deferred_intents.disposition flipped to 'admitted' and a NEW queued task_run created for it (same tx).

run_id.description: The NEW run created for the promoted intent

RunLeaseLostV1.description: RecoverySweeper found a nonterminal run whose lease_expires_at lapsed. The run is blocked (actor=policy, error_code='lease_lost') in the same tx; its admission slot stays counted until stop is confirmed (docs/design/vtx-5-scheduler.md §5).

action.description: What the sweeper did; extensible to 'released' if a future policy auto-releases

RunRequirementReadyV1.description: VTX-6: frozen RequirementPacket persisted for the run. requirement_hash is what downstream audit/QA pins to.

RunBaselineRecordedV1.description: VTX-6: baseline suite executed on base_sha and recorded as verification_runs kind='baseline'. A 'failed' baseline is data, not a dispatch blocker (vtx-6 §4.2).

QAVerdictRecordedV1.description: Payload for event_type qa.verdict_recorded.v1 (VTX-9 → orchestrator/gate). Written in the same transaction as the qa_verdicts row, so a published event always has a committed verdict at the same attempt. The verdict is bound to the exact commit_sha the QA agent evaluated (FR-QA-001/003).

attempt.description: task_runs.attempt the verdict belongs to; one verdict per (run_id, attempt)

commit_sha.description: Exact commit SHA the QA agent evaluated. Must equal task_runs.commit_sha at submission; a later SHA change invalidates this verdict for gate purposes (FR-QA-003).

findings.description: Structured findings only — never raw transcripts or secrets (NFR-AUD-001).

qa_session_id.description: VTX-7 agent session ID of the QA run. Must differ from the coding session ID (independence assertion, FR-QA-001).

qa_agent_identity.description: Authenticated QA principal, e.g. 'qa-agent:pi@0.x' — never the coding agent identity.

coding_session_id.description: Snapshot of the coding session ID recorded at QA launch, for the independence check.

evidence_ids.description: evidence_artifacts.artifact_id values backing this verdict; must include at least one producer='qa_agent', kind='qa_test_run' artifact bound to commit_sha.

evaluated_at.description: When the QA agent finished evaluation (RFC3339 UTC).

GateConditionResult.description: One mandatory-condition outcome inside a gate decision. Every policy condition appears exactly once per decision — a condition that was not reached is recorded with satisfied=false and detail='not evaluated', never omitted.

name.description: Condition identifier from the policy, e.g. 'run_in_quality_gate', 'sha_binding', 'verification_green', 'qa_verdict_pass', 'qa_executed_tests', 'lease_fencing', 'no_superseding_attempt'.

blocking.description: Always true for vtx-gate-policy/v1 — all listed conditions are mandatory (FR-QA-002).

detail.description: Machine-readable reason when unsatisfied, e.g. 'no qa_verdict for commit_sha'.

evidence_artifact_ids.description: Artifacts the condition was evaluated against.

QualityGateDecisionV1.description: Payload for event_type quality_gate.decision.v1 (VTX-10). Mirror of the persisted gate_decisions row — the decision record schema including SHA binding fields. Emitted in the same transaction as the row, for both standalone evaluations and (conceptually) the advance-time recompute. The advance guard never trusts a stored decision; it recomputes on the locked run row, so this event is audit/evidence, not authorization.

subject_commit_sha.description: SHA the decision binds to — copied from the task_runs row locked FOR UPDATE at evaluation time (FR-QA-003).

verified_head_sha.description: SHA independently resolved from the run worktree HEAD at evaluation time. Divergence from subject_commit_sha fails the sha_binding condition.

policy_version.description: e.g. 'v1' — the policy snapshot evaluated; guards always run the current version.

decision.description: pass ⇔ every blocking condition satisfied. Deterministic — no free-text input enters the decision (FR-QA-002).

blocking_reasons.description: Names of unsatisfied blocking conditions, e.g. ['qa_verdict_pass'].

evaluator.description: System identity that evaluated, e.g. 'gate-engine' — never a human or agent principal.

RunEvidenceInvalidatedV1.description: Payload for event_type run.evidence_invalidated.v1 (emitted by the commit-recording path — VTX-8 writes it, VTX-9/10 consumers react to it). Signals that task_runs.commit_sha changed while QA verdicts and/or gate decisions existed for the previous SHA: those rows stay as audit history but no guard may accept them (FR-QA-003, E2E-05).

OutboxDeliveryRedrivenV1.description: Payload for event_type outbox.delivery_redriven.v1 (VTX-11 operator action). Emitted in the same transaction that clears the DLQ marker and inserts the delivery_redrives audit row (FR-EVT-002 audited redrive, E2E-07).

event_type.description: The redriven outbox event's type, e.g. 'execution_intent.created.v1'.
